articles.description: China has flown its large, jet-powered Jiutian drone for the first time. The aircraft is much bigger than many military drones in service today. The Galaxy S26 is at Rs 89,999, the S26 Plus at Rs 1,14,999 and the S26 Ultra at Rs 1,24,999, which adds a Privacy Display. The Galaxy Z Fold 7 is listed at Rs 1,29,999, down from Rs 2,04,999.
